turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to learn an instrument this year and I'm torn between a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is guitar, which I could use to play songs with friends around a fire.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's piano, which my neighbor says is the best way to learn music theory.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is drums, really fun but loud, and I live in an apartment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Guitar is a great social instrument and it's easy to carry around. Piano really does make music theory clear, since you can see all the notes laid out. Drums sound fun, but in an apartment you'd probably need an electronic kit with headphones.
